map.普伦蒂斯法则：棱镜度 P = 移心量(cm) × |度数 F|；移心量 c =: Prentice's rule: prism diopters P = decentration (cm) × |power F|; decentration c = P / |F|
map.镜片光学中心偏离视线 c(cm) 即产生 P=c·|F| 棱镜度；正镜向基底方向: When the lens optical center deviates from the line of sight by c (cm), it produces P=c·|F| prism diopters; a plus lens is decentered toward the base direction and a minus lens in the opposite direction.
map.Prentice 法则：P(Δ) = c(cm) × F(D)。正镜(远视)向基:
Prentice's rule: P(Δ) = c(cm) × F(D). A plus lens (hyperopia) decentered toward the base direction produces that base prism; a minus lens (myopia) must be decentered opposite to the base.
      BI=base nasal, BO=base temporal, BU=base up, BD=base down.
map.移心产生棱镜的度数有限（一般≤3-4Δ），过大棱镜需直接加工棱镜而非移心。负镜度: The prism produced by decentration is limited (generally ≤3-4Δ); larger prisms require directly grinding a prism rather than decentering. The higher the minus lens power, the larger the prism produced by the same decentration.
map.本工具基于薄镜片 Prentice 法则，忽略厚镜片与高阶效应。临床棱镜处方请以: This tool is based on the thin-lens Prentice's rule, ignoring thick-lens and higher-order effects. For clinical prism prescriptions, follow the ophthalmologist/optometrist's prescription.

map.光度 −5.00D、光学中心偏移 1cm → 棱镜 P=c×F=1×5=5Δ（底: Power −5.00D, optical center offset 1 cm → prism P=c×F=1×5=5Δ (base in the offset direction); used to compensate exophoria.
map.装配棱镜允差通常 ±0.5Δ，移心 1cm 在 −5D 下产生 5Δ，超单眼 2: The assembly prism tolerance is usually ±0.5Δ; a 1 cm decentration at −5D produces 5Δ, exceeding 2Δ per eye and easily causing discomfort, so precision is needed or a prism lens should be used.
map.普伦蒂斯法则：棱镜度=移心量(cm)×该点屈光度(D)，底向由移心方向定。: Prentice's rule: prism diopters = decentration (cm) × the power at that point (D), with the base direction determined by the decentration direction.
map.何时用棱镜片而非移心？: When to use a prism lens instead of decentration?
map.需求棱镜大（>2Δ）或高度数移心致厚薄不均时，直接磨棱镜片更准。: When the required prism is large (>2Δ) or a high-power decentration causes uneven thickness, directly grinding a prism lens is more accurate.
